class_scheme: AAMI 5-class (N/S/V/F/Q), grouped from the 13-class MIT-BIH labels
data_source: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database (PhysioNet), real per-beat features
notes: 109494 real annotated heartbeats across 13 classes, extracted via wfdb. See ml/data/arrhythmia_classes.json for class names. Trained on the AAMI 5-class grouping with soft-balanced sample weights, not the raw 13-class labels.

data_source: UCI Heart Failure Prediction (Cleveland/Hungary/Switzerland/VA + Statlog merge)
notes: 918 real patient records. Download CDC BRFSS 2015 (253,680 rows) and set QTI_BRFSS_CSV for full 10k+ scale training. Default 0.5 threshold used (tested against recall-tuning; default gave both higher accuracy and higher recall on this roughly-balanced dataset).

data_source: CDC NHANES 2005-2006, 2007-2008, 2009-2010, 2011-2012, 2013-2014, 2015-2016, 2017-2020 (7 cycles), real lab-measured glucose/BMI/cholesterol + measured-BP-derived hypertension
notes: 43346 real participant records, 1805 stroke-positive (4.16%). Built via ml/download_nhanes.py + ml/extract_nhanes_features.py; see ML_MODELS_EXPLAINED.md and ml/DATASETS.md for full provenance. Honest expectation: stroke is a rare event even in a national survey sample (typically well under 5% positive here), so at high precision thresholds recall will still be limited by class imbalance -- NHANES's advantage over BRFSS/Kaggle is that its glucose/BMI/cholesterol are lab-measured rather than self-reported/binary, which should sharpen the precision-recall curve at a given operating point, not eliminate the fundamental rare-event ceiling. Compare against cardiac_evaluation_report.json's prior BRFSS/Kaggle runs before treating any single metric improvement as conclusive. Includes engineered comorbidity interaction features: round 1 (age_hypertension, bmi_diabetes, glucose_hba1c, age_heart_disease) and round 2 (bmi_waist_circumference, age_smoking, cholesterol_hypertension, age_bmi, sex_age, waist_circumference_hypertension, physical_activity_bmi). Threshold tuned to guarantee >= 78% recall. Hyperparameters tuned specifically for stroke (previously copy-pasted from heart_disease_rf, now round-2 widened grid incl. l2_regularization); 20 low-value columns dropped via permutation importance (10 candidate missing-flags + 23 candidate non-flag features screened).
